usage: The word 嘴 is a noun and refers to the beak of a bird or the mouth of an animal.
In Cantonese, 嘴 can be used to describe both the physical part on animals and birds or metaphorically to refer to the mouth as a body part in humans.
It often appears in combination with other words to specify types of mouths or beaks, such as 鳥嘴 (bird beak) or 狗嘴 (dog's mouth).
When used in a sentence, 嘴 typically functions as the subject or object to indicate something related to the mouth or beak.
The pronunciation zeoi2 emphasizes the rising tone, which is important for clear communication.

examples.meaning: This bird has a very long beak.
